kind: pre-registered ablation (FRETISH), two arms of one binary, with a score phase
kind_note: Sweep O, ordered_fields = directed against uniform, over 20 FRETISH subjects at 30 seeds. The curve phase was declared in campaign.toml as phase 2. On av2 it was split off into the companion declaration 2026-09-29-fretish-ablation-score, which this archive folds in as campaign-score.toml; see score_campaign_folded.
question: On FRETISH, does directed mutation of the three ordered requirement fields (timing, condition type, scope) find repairs more often or sooner than a uniform redraw of the same fields? (PLAN.md, Question.)
endpoint: Primary: found at the cap, anytime, McNemar exact two-sided at alpha 0.05 over the 600 (subject, seed) pairs. Secondary: found at 10 s and at 100 s under the same test; paired wall time by the Wilcoxon signed-rank test on pairs where both arms finished. implies_ideal descriptive on 6 subjects. (PLAN.md, Endpoints and tests.)
decision_rule: Directed wins if McNemar's p < 0.05 and more discordant pairs favour directed. Uniform wins under the symmetric condition. Any other outcome is null. (PLAN.md.)
decision_rule_firing: Uniform wins. At the cap the directed arm holds a repair on 550 of 600 runs and the uniform arm on 570; 1 discordant pair favours directed and 21 favour uniform, exact McNemar p = 1.1e-05. 21 of the 22 discordant pairs are rad-core-10 (directed 9 of 30, uniform 30 of 30) and the other is fsm-lmcps (directed 1 of 30, uniform 0 of 30). The other 18 subjects tie at 30 of 30 on both arms.

arms.shared: selection nsga2-apportion, status grading mrs, weights 0.1/0.2/0.7, log metric, weakening off, termination individuals at 1000, population 100, generations 500 (ceiling), parallel 1, gen_configs.py --pin-vintage, 7200 s runner cap, no max_wall_s

corpus: 20 subjects: 8 whole specs (takeoff, fsm, fsm-timing, fsm-combined, fsm-lmcps, liquid-mixer, mode-arbiter, valu3s-uc6) and 12 unrealisable cores (rad-core-1-18, -10, -12-18, -17-18, -33, -45, -55, -61, -65, -68; lpc-mini-core1; lpc-full-core1). 20 x 2 arms x 30 seeds = 1200 runs.

Its curves are disjoint by seed from the parent's and join into one CSV, and the primary endpoint reads all 1200 of them, so a separate archive would split one endpoint across two folders. The declaration is kept verbatim so the seed split stays reproducible.

deviations: The curve phase for av2's seeds was split off into a second declaration and run across both hosts (f3cd190), after av3 finished its half about 9 h ahead. The budgets and command were unchanged.
The av3 score manifest of the parent's curve phase was overwritten; see not_recorded.
caveats: One subject carries the primary. rad-core-10 supplies 21 of the 22 discordant pairs at the cap, and without it the arms differ by one run in 570 pairs. The decision is the registered reading, and it describes a corpus-level effect concentrated on one core.
rad-core-10's directed arm found a repair on 2 of 15 seeds on av2 and 7 of 15 on av3; both arms of each pair ran on the same host, so the host difference does not bias the paired test.
Found is anytime, read from accumulated candidates that have passed the realisability and well-separation gate. The results CSV's found_repair, read at run end, gives 520 against 540.
Cores, valu3s-uc6 and mode-arbiter carry no reachable ideal, so implies_ideal reads on 6 subjects only.
av3's clock runs about 17 minutes fast with NTP off.
